outgoing.name: English language
outgoing.excerpt: The Gaylords’ hits, like “Ti Mako”, “Pray for the Blackman”, “Lovely Dominica” and “Douvan Jo”, were either English or the native Creole, kwéyòl.

outgoing.name: Full moon
outgoing.excerpt: Bélé are folk songs traditionally performed recreationally in the evening during the full moon, and more rarely, lavèyé ( wakes).
